name: Flipkart
tagline: India's largest homegrown e-commerce marketplace, majority-owned by Walmart
facts: FY25 Flipkart Internet ₹20,807 cr; loss ₹1,494 cr
FY25 Flipkart India net loss ₹5,189 cr
~35% of India e-com MAUs incl. Myntra (2026)
Redomiciled to India Dec 2025; IPO deferred to ~2028

strategy.label: Mission
strategy.text: Transform commerce in India through technology, making quality goods accessible and affordable for every Indian.

strategy.label: Vision
strategy.text: Be the default commerce, payments and quick-delivery platform for India's next 500 million online shoppers.

strategy.label: Core strategy
strategy.text: Value-first marketplace for Bharat: tier-2/3 depth, vernacular UX, affordability via EMI, Pay Later and bank offers.

strategy.label: Moat
strategy.text: Ekart logistics reach, Big Billion Days brand, smartphone and fashion category leadership, Myntra in the family.

strategy.label: Key bet
strategy.text: Flipkart Minutes quick commerce: ~800 dark stores early 2026, targeting 2,000 by mid-2027; EBITDA breakeven by FY27.

strategy.label: Your view
strategy.text: Should Flipkart burn cash on Minutes before IPO, or protect the profitability story Walmart now demands?

customers.pain: Low trust, limited cards, need affordable branded goods and COD
customers.why: Vernacular app, COD, EMI and Pay Later, deep festive discounts

customers.pain: Want fast delivery and best price on high-ticket items
customers.why: Exclusive phone launches, bank offers, Minutes for 10-minute delivery

customers.who: 1.4M+ sellers, MSMEs, D2C and OEM brands
customers.pain: Need national reach, logistics and working capital
customers.why: Largest Indian buyer base, Ekart fulfilment, seller loans, lower-commission programs

customers.who: Brands and sellers buying Flipkart Ads
customers.pain: Need measurable sales lift at point of purchase
customers.why: Closed-loop retail media; ads revenue ₹6,317 cr FY25 (+27%)

customers.who: Ekart riders, dark-store staff, kirana partners
customers.pain: Need steady income and festive-season work
customers.why: Large hiring during BBD, predictable volumes, gig flexibility

products.name: Flipkart Plus / Black
products.desc: Loyalty tiers with early sale access and perks

products.name: Big Billion Days
products.desc: Annual festive sale; 2026 edition from 9 Oct

portfolio.north_star: Monthly transacting users completing a delivered, non-returned order
portfolio.key_metrics: GMV, MAU to buyer conversion, AOV, tier-2/3 share, repeat rate
portfolio.guardrails: Return/RTO rate, delivery promise breach, contribution margin per order

products.name: Myntra
products.desc: Fashion and beauty arm; profitable, M-Now quick fashion

products.name: Cleartrip
products.desc: Travel booking for flights and hotels

products.name: Flipkart Wholesale
products.desc: B2B supply to kiranas and retailers

portfolio.north_star: Weekly Minutes orders per active user in live pin codes
portfolio.key_metrics: Daily orders (1M+), dark-store throughput, delivery time, basket size
portfolio.guardrails: Burn per order, stockouts, rider safety, cannibalisation of core

products.name: Flipkart Ads
products.desc: Sponsored listings, brand display and video ads

products.name: Ekart
products.desc: Logistics arm also serving third-party shippers

portfolio.north_star: Take rate on GMV from fees, ads and fintech
portfolio.key_metrics: Ad revenue per seller, ROAS, credit approvals, Ekart external volume
portfolio.guardrails: Ad load on search, credit defaults, seller fee churn

rows.how: Commission, collection, shipping fees; FY25 ₹7,751 cr, doubled
CPC and display ads; FY25 ₹6,317 cr (+27%)
Ekart delivery fees; FY25 ₹4,224 cr, down from ₹6,838 cr
Flipkart India buys and resells goods; thin margin, most revenue

rows.who_uses: Shoppers paying by UPI or credit
rows.how: Lending referral fees, bank-offer co-funding, platform fees

bullets.label: Revenue mix
bullets.text: Marketplace arm: fees and ads are two-thirds of ₹20,807 cr FY25. Group revenue dominated by wholesale trading.

bullets.label: Users vs payers
bullets.text: Shoppers rarely pay directly; sellers fund the platform via commission, ads and logistics fees.

bullets.label: Unit economics
bullets.text: Marketplace loss narrowed 37% in FY25, but group loss widened to ₹5,189 cr on Minutes and discounts.

bullets.label: Growth levers
bullets.text: Minutes in 250+ cities, ads take rate, Shopsy for value, super.money credit cross-sell.

friction: Fake or poor-quality items on some 3P listings
Returns and refunds slow, often disputed
Platform and handling fees add surprise costs
Bank-offer pricing confusing; best price hard to find

competitors.label: Horizontal
competitors.text: Amazon India, Reliance JioMart, Tata Neu

competitors.label: Quick commerce
competitors.text: Blinkit, Swiggy Instamart, Zepto, Amazon Now, BigBasket

competitors.label: Edge
competitors.text: Indian MAU lead, Bharat reach, smartphone category leadership, Walmart backing

competitors.label: Risk
competitors.text: Losses, FDI inventory rules, CCI probes, quick-commerce cash burn

news.label: Oct 2026
news.text: Big Billion Days 2026 live from 9 Oct; Plus/Black early access 8 Oct

news.label: May 2026
news.text: IPO put on hold; listing deferred to ~2028 pending EBITDA breakeven

news.label: Dec 2025
news.text: NCLT approves redomicile from Singapore to India, a pre-IPO step

news.label: Watch
news.text: FY26 filings, Minutes losses, DRHP timing, Amazon Now's $3B challenge

sources: RoC filings via Inc42/Entrackr/Business Standard, Walmart disclosures, press coverage. MAU share and metrics are estimates for PM interview prep. Prepared Oct 2026.
